title: Watch Wrist Time Log Weekly Days Since Wear Trend
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watch:wristtime days_since_wear=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_since_wear) as avg_duration, max(days_since_wear) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days since wear for watch wrist-time log events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_since_wear on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days since wear with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether watch wrist-time log tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
